commentary: With Nifty plunging 1.64% on RBI tightening and crude surging above $103, market breadth has deteriorated to 46, triggering deterministic CAUTION. Under Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil disciplines, three out of four equities mirror general market distribution; fighting broad index downdrafts is a cardinal mistake. Jesse Livermore emphasized sitting tight in cash when headwinds mount. Mark Minervini's progressive exposure dictates zero aggressive capital deployment until a verified follow-through day emerges. In this environment, strict earnings discipline is paramount: setups lacking accelerating earnings growth must remain on the sidelines.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis Frameworks

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Consolidating in a tight 30-session box above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, pressing against overhead resistance. However, it lacks institutional sponsorship and relative strength in the microcap space.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction (-56.3%) and negative earnings trajectory (-25.5%) fail CANSLIM standards. Subdued ROCE of ~5.6% and weak coverage amplify balance sheet risks.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Fails on a breakdown below base support at 99.05; Minervini risk discipline mandates immediate stop execution.

ABDL.technical: Carves a double bottom above rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA. Neckline pressure near 754.55 shows supply absorption, while RSI at 70 reflects healthy momentum without excessive extension.
ABDL.fundamental: Modest 6.1% sales expansion is heavily undercut by declining net earnings (-13.0% YoY) and rich multiples, falling short of O'Neil current earnings criteria.
ABDL.risk: Thesis breaks below the 693.33 swing trough; strict stop enforcement prevents capital destruction.

ACE.technical: Demonstrates Stage 2 leadership above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Tight two-low structure within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot signals orderly institutional absorption.
ACE.fundamental: Capital goods leader with robust ~20% ROCE and minimal leverage. Operating sales grew +18.9%, but EPS growth decelerated slightly to +22.3%, trailing CANSLIM's 25% threshold.
ACE.risk: Invalidated if price breaches support at 1184.64; cut losses quickly per SEPA loss-cutting rules.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Displays textbook SEPA pullback action, respecting the rising 21-EMA before a bullish reclaim. RSI at 63 and higher pivot lows against neckline point to accumulation.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Outstanding top-line (+67.8%) and PAT (+79.9%) acceleration reflecting asset scale-up. Utility-style capital intensity and elevated leverage restrain overall return metrics (ROCE ~8.3%).
ACMESOLAR.risk: Breach below 435.78 invalidates the pattern; exit immediately to manage downside exposure.

ADANIPORTS.technical: Large-cap structure holding above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Formed aligned swing lows with RSI at 58, consolidating right under key resistance.
ADANIPORTS.fundamental: Dominant logistics moat drove +18.6% revenue growth. However, EPS momentum decelerated to +9.2% YoY, and significant debt load limits CANSLIM leadership standing.
ADANIPORTS.risk: Setup fails on a close below 1771.57; cut loss immediately to preserve trading capital.

ADFFOODS.technical: Darvas box breakout clearing 20-day highs on 4.45× volume. Price trades cleanly above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, demonstrating high relative strength during index liquidation.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Clean balance sheet, virtually debt-free with ROCE ~22% and +25.9% revenue expansion. Yet EPS growth slowed to +13.5% YoY, capping the setup under CANSLIM rules.
ADFFOODS.risk: Break below the 308.38 anchor low voids the breakout; trigger immediate stop discipline.
